crossRefs.note: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.
The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

translations.web: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
translations.bsb: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
translations.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
translations.asv: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.
